title: Supply secrets at install time

scenes.heading: The installer needs a secret
scenes.result: Keep the value out of the bundle
voice: A Run AI cluster needs a bootstrap token when it is installed.
The bundle may travel between teams, so supply that credential only on the install machine.

scenes.heading: Describe the required input
scenes.result: Only the input slot is declared
voice: The catalog marks the bootstrap token as an install time secret.
Declare its path as dynamic at bundle time so the generated bundle carries a place to supply it.

scenes.heading: Hand off the bundle before the token
scenes.sub: Show only the generated input slot
voice: The generated component includes a cluster values file for install time inputs.
The install side fills the required slot there when it is ready to deploy.

scenes.heading: Apply from the installation environment
scenes.sub: The deployer consumes the filled values
voice: The deployment tool reads the filled values during installation.
The team that generated the artifact can hand it off before anyone supplies the actual credential.

viewer: Integrator handing off a credentialed install
payoff: Show a required bootstrap-token slot moving into an install-time values file while the generated bundle stays free of the token.
